description: Intent i003 (SNAPSHOT=s01, BRANCH=sysfs-store-attr-terminator) complete. Two high-confidence findings of the seed's usercopy-then-string-parser invariant in sysfs/configfs attribute stores: (1) drivers/target/target_core_alua.c:1914-1924 core_alua_store_tg_pt_gp_info() — 'unsigned char buf[TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF]' (256, include/target/target_core_base.h:36), off-by-one check 'if (count > TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF)' accepts count==256, memset(buf,0,256) then 'memcpy(buf, page, count)' fills all 256 bytes with no terminator slot (page's trailing NUL at page[count] not copied), then 'strcmp(strstrip(buf), "NULL")' plus core_alua_get_tg_pt_gp_by_name(strstrip(buf)) run strlen/strcmp past the 256-byte stack array (KASAN stack OOB read). (2) drivers/target/target_core_configfs.c:2446-2455 target_dev_alua_lu_gp_store() — same off-by-one bound (count > LU_GROUP_NAME_BUF(256)) with 'memcpy(buf, page, count)' into buf[256]={ } and 'strcmp(strstrip(buf), "NULL")' on the unterminated result. Unresolved (limitations): speakup synth_store (drivers/accessibility/speakup/kobjects.c:386) and versal_edac inject_data_ue_store (drivers/edac/versal_edac.c:848, a 1-byte OOB write buf[len]='\0' with len==sizeof(buf)==6 in a debugfs-style handler — belongs to the debugfs branch); the store-callback sweep was heuristic regex over .c files, so macro/inline-defined stores and module_param handlers were not exhaustively enumerated.
